entities.summary: The politics of Egypt take place within the framework of a republican semi-presidential system of government. The current political system was established following the 2013 Egyptian military coup d'état, and the assumption of office by President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi. In the current system, the President is elected for a six-year term. Furthermore, the President has the power to dissolve Parliament under Article 137. The Parliament of Egypt is the oldest legislative chamber in Africa and the Middle East.
